children: Editor's note: This article was updated on Sept. 11 at 11a with a formal declaration from the CDC.
The CDC on Friday declared that the Cyclospora outbreak that began in July and has sickened over 12,800 individuals has ended.
The agency noted that recent infections linked to the outbreak have dropped significantly. However, its investigation into the cause will continue.
first reported on Thursday that the end of the outbreak announcement was imminent.

In mid-July, Taylor issued a recall.
Michigan was hit the hardest by the outbreak. Two people in the state with underlying health conditions died after infection.
